title: Notion-like Database Table — full table with import/export + row peek + relation/rollup (11 views · 18 cells · CSV + JSON)
description: Portable Notion-style database surface. Optional companion to notion-shell. NotionDatabase ships full DB UI with ViewTabs + ViewOptions + per-column menu + 11 views (Table / Board / List / Gallery / Calendar / Feed / Chart / Dashboard / Form / Map / Timeline) + FilterBuilder + SortBuilder + 18 property-cell types (text / number / checkbox / select / multi_select / status / date / url / email / phone / files / person / formula / relation / rollup / created_time / last_edited_time / unique_id). FormView submits via onRowCreate callback. v0.7 adds RowPeek (sheet + dialog + persisted mode toggle). v0.8 adds RelationCell (cross-database link picker w/ optional create-new affordance) + RollupCell (aggregates relation targets — count/sum/avg/min/max/values/earliest/latest/checked/percent_checked). Both wire via new NotionDatabase props (pages, databases, onCreateRelatedRow) so host stays the source of truth. Pure / props-driven.

peers.reason: Domain types (Database, Property, PropertyValue, DbView, RollupAggregate, DatabaseViewConfig, DatabaseFilter, DatabaseSort) live in notion-shell — the Page type references them via rowOfDatabaseId + rowProps so they stay in the shell's domain model. v0.5 extends Property with relation + rollup fields.
